proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11580 vālukā gives neighboring bālu/bāluwā sand. Hajong bulu is compared with this u-final sand family with raising/rounding of the first vowel qualified; it does not select the i-final vālikā branch. Exact survey form bulu is preserved.
